aliases.clarify: Universal health coverage includes service coverage and financial protection. Identify which concept the user needs.
Incidence rate and incident case count are different measures. Confirm the unit and whether HIV-specific or age-specific estimates are intended.
For retrieval distinguish reported versus estimated data, percentage versus population count, and population strata. Discovery can list these candidates without asking first.
Confirm the budget threshold for data retrieval, as well as reported versus estimated data and percentage versus population count.
